newsitem.title: SPAIN: Grenade hits Spanish barracks, seen as ETA attack.
newsitem.headline: Grenade hits Spanish barracks, seen as ETA attack.

text.p: Three grenades were launched at a Spanish police barracks in the northern Basque region early on Wednesday in an attack officials attributed to ETA Basque separatist guerrillas, police said.

They said the attackers had set up five grenade launchers on a timing system, but only three went off and only one actually hit the installations, where police officers live without their families. There was little damage and no one was injured.
Police detained two people who were in the area, but did not immediately make any charges.

The attack was similar to one last March that ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has claimed, and to another one a month later that the then Interior Minister Margarita Robles said was the work of ETA.
ETA has often targeted security forces in its struggle for Basque independence, in which it has killed some 800 people since 1968.
